_about: Trimmed real records from 2026-10-19: one Yelp business page (Web Unlocker raw HTML), the Yelp reviews scraper, two public job boards and one LinkedIn company record. Businesses only: owner names, reviewer names, photo authors and review text were removed. Field names are exactly as each source returns them; long lists are cut to 1-2 items.

yelp_biz_page.source: Web Unlocker, url https://www.yelp.com/biz/bansho-ramen-berkeley-3, format raw. Entries from the data-apollo-state script. 27.5 s, 2026-10-19T19:06:45Z.
yelp_biz_page.note: Read claimability({"useConsumerClaimability":true}).isClaimed, not claimability. The page HTML holds 0 reviews. lat/lng: map image src, center=37.864882%2C-122.258850.

yelp_jsonld_photo_reviews.source: Same page, <script type="application/ld+json"> ItemList of ImageObject. No extra call.
yelp_jsonld_photo_reviews.note: Photo-attached reviews only: 40 entries, 28 unique dated ratings for Bansho after merging local-time and UTC copies, 2019-03-27 to 2026-04-15, mean 3.86 (overall 4.1). The earliest gives 'reviews on Yelp since at least 2019'. author fields removed. Earliest and latest shown.

yelp_reviews_scraper.note: Partial and flaky: 10 of 196 Bansho reviews in 408.8 s on the run that returned anything, all recommended_review false. Older dates are year-precision (Oct 19-21 of each year). Review_auther, Content and profile_pic_url removed: never store them. Oldest and newest shown.

job_board_greenhouse.source: GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/stripe/jobs?content=true, plain fetch, no Bright Data. 0.73 s.
job_board_greenhouse.note: meta.total was 723. content (long HTML) and compliance fields removed. Newest posting shown.

job_board_ashby.source: GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/snowflake?includeCompensation=true, plain fetch, no Bright Data. 0.49 s.
job_board_ashby.note: 355 jobs. Description and compensation removed. Newest posting shown.

linkedin_company.note: funding, crunchbase_url, investors and stock_info were empty on 48 of 48 live records. additional_information 'open jobs' is LinkedIn-wide keyword totals, not this company's openings. updates[].title is who posted; keep only the company's own posts.
